title.narrative: Sustainable and Inclusive Tourism Development Project in Himachal Pradesh

description.narrative: The proposed project targets the following impact: tourism economy in the five districts (Hamirpur, Kangra, Kullu, Mandi, and Shimla) make a complete recovery from the pandemic downturn and return to steady growth trajectory. Sustainable and resilient tourism interventions help in spreading social and economic benefits of tourism more widely within the five districts. The project's outcomes are - a vibrant tourism economy, improved sustainability of destinations, resilience to seasonality, effectiveness in spreading economic benefits and an enhanced profile as a preferred tourism destination.
